scope: Local assembly and repository-lookup experiments; no full-review speed or quality claim

C1.rss_interpretation: Initial whole-process peak RSS did not meet the planned 20 percent reduction. Different workloads share this process; this is not per-workload memory.
limitations: The initial routine median increased; isolated 20-run controls did not reproduce that regression.
Preparation time and allocations are not full model-review latency or quality.

C2.scope: Tracked local checkout, twelve windows of one 4096-line source and eight identical grep queries, fresh lookup session per sample. This does not measure whole review speed or quality.
C2.cto: C2 code approach GO, conditional on race; current memo/review race run passed after this review. Overall program approval remains pending.
limitations: The local worktree remains mutable as before; this is captured-source sharing, not a new immutable snapshot guarantee.
Oversized source is returned without retention to preserve Jev input; its pre-existing transient full-file allocation remains.
The 8 MiB admission budget charges retained payloads, line indexes, query text and entry estimates; it is not a process RSS cap.

C3_detect.decision: Do not change production: large-change median regresses from 400.5 to 617.0 microseconds; absolute changes are small and mixed.
C3_detect.scope: Real default built-in Detect on materialized frozen source snapshots. No analyzers or models executed.

C4_source_profile.scope: Real frozen source, scripted model, in-memory provider; default and $0.03 modeled budget; no network, source execution or real quality measurement.
C4_source_profile.result: Provider file reads fall from558 to447 on large default and598 to452 with budget; in-memory latency regresses on most workloads. A network-cost control and bounded implementation are needed before promotion.
C4_source_profile.request_identity: Plan, budget decision, full ordered messages and SDK call options per request are hashed; independent batch request arrival is canonicalized as a multiset, not claimed identical in arrival order.

network_control.scope: Simulated2ms per FileContent/ListDir dispatch; no actual provider
network_control.decision: No universal cache: results remain mixed and local/no-delay paths regressed. Keep production unchanged; any future remote-only cache needs a representative remote trace and bounded memory.

C5_engineering_spans.scope: Engineering preparation only; no model/analyzer dispatch; default configuration with engineering profile and actual framing reserve.

identity.kind: same engineering preparation; candidate byte-offset span selection

verification.cto: C5-only GO; dependent race condition satisfied.

limitations: Three profiling samples support this engineering-preparation comparison; no p95 or whole-review latency/quality estimate is claimed.
Existing task skips and omissions are unchanged, not removed.
The count-preserving byte-offset selector does not change request tokens or model billing.

C6_remaining_candidate_profile.scope: scripted large-change review preparation, budget off, source memo off, 10 iterations, one CPU profile; no provider calls

cumulative_cpu_share.knowledge retrieval: not exercised: fixture has no knowledge index

decisions.prompt_rendering_dedup: Not implemented: 2.5% of CPU in this normal-review preparation profile. This alone does not measure a dedup prototype or bound other modes.
decisions.analyzer_model_overlap: Unmeasured: this harness disables actual linters; the C3 Detect microbenchmark is not a profile of analyzer/model overlap.
decisions.bounded_full_file_prefetch: Unmeasured: C4 measured source-read memoization, not parallel initial full-file fetches. Do not use its result to reject prefetch.
decisions.per_file_knowledge_lookup: unmeasured: needs a scripted knowledge index fixture before any claim
decisions.flow_diagram: Candidate only: 26.7% of this CPU profile; needs an output oracle before any change. No measured wall-time improvement.

C7_analyzer_overlap.scope: Actual golangci-lint plus scripted model responses on all five frozen source snapshots. 20 runs per variant; GOMAXPROCS=4. No model service delay and no provider call. Ordered whole report and per-request messages/options hash matches; independent request arrivals are canonicalized as a multiset.
C7_analyzer_overlap.order: all serial samples before all concurrent samples; shared-host/cache drift remains possible
C7_analyzer_overlap.decision: All five prototype medians regressed (about 0.4% to 9.2%); restore serial production scheduling. Shared-host drift is possible. No network model latency was simulated, so no claim is made about that case.
